about: 4 putts that should've gone in, then you reacting: 1) "get a double, get a double" → lips out → hand over mouth, "oh it lipped… freaking lipped" 2) "this is for par" → "break in, break in" → misses → "there's really nothing worse than having a perfect drive and then being shit the rest of the time, but here we are for bogey" 3) "there's a lot riding on this… you're so embarrassed at this bogey" → "I should not speak while I putt— oh" → miss, putter kick → "doesn't freaking matter" 4) ends on "that was a tough four putt, but at least I look so cute in my new shirt". Every putt kept whole, no words cut. Outfits alternate (green → white/camo → dark green → orange checker). Nothing from comps that posted/are scheduled. 43 s, full-quality export from your originals.
